description: I live to serve me and provide myself with the best experience life has to offer #chooseme #audacity #selflovejourney
transcript: Everything that I do is for my entertainment. Everything that I do is for a little jokey, a little laughy for Tally. The more that I have changed my lens from I am here to serve everything and everyone else, I have moved myself away from needing validation from the external world. This world and this time on here is so short. We are all on a rock just moving and shaking around. There is no handbook for how we do it. But I'm doing it and I'm doing it in a way that feels organic and a way that feels natural. I don't want to be anything other than myself. I do not want to live this life in order to seek acceptance. I accept me and I have fun with me.
